notes.title: Final polish update!
notes.notes:
- clown animations fixed
- atrium gravel path added
- cheat codes fully implemented, no longer experimental

notes.title: Atrium Beautification
notes.notes: Overhaul of the plant life in the atrium on level one, added grass, bushes, flowers, increased the quality of the ground mesh and texture

notes.title: Cheat codes and hard mode bug fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]Check out Level 3 and Hard Mode if you haven't[/b]

- interacting with the gold trophy in the statistics room unlocks cheats (pressing the reset button resets this): Hitting L on a level will bring you to the next level (WARNING: Experimental, do not attempt to access a level beyond your chosen difficulty), there will also appear three buttons on the whiteboard in the trophy room to unlock all items from each level

- level three's enemies' animations needed to be adjusted slightly, they will now stand still if you are unreachable

- changed the how to play menu slightly, added cheat button etc.

notes.title: 0.3.3 Steam Achievements
notes.notes: Added the first 5 steam achievements, basically get both of the trophies and you'll get the achievements, there's one kinda fun easter egg achievement, more in future. Also, I'll be testing this in the near future so expect potential bugs solved soon. Have fun y'all!

notes.title: 0.3.2 The Pingo Update
notes.notes: Don't worry guys Pingo the Clown has been added to level two, if you find his picture and interact with it, it will be added to the trophy room!

notes.title: 0.3.1 Trophy Room Tracker
notes.notes: Added a whiteboard in the trophy room so you can keep track of how many items are left on each level. This is more important now that levels are locked until completing the previous difficulty. Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: Forget Something? 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Added progression system. Now you have to collect the 5 unique items from level 1, then the level 1 trophy before you gain access to level 2. This will be the same system for accessing level 3 (which isn't out yet, but will be soon)

Additionally, the difficulty menu now has some (hopefully) helpful explanatory text and changed it from being a default drop down to a custom-made multiple choice menu.

Check your progress in the trophy room (accessed via the statistics menu).

notes.title: 0.2.15 Just the clicking sound is updated
notes.notes: Yeah literally I updated the game and immediately went "wow guess you can't hear that" So yeah thats louder now. Still have the light fixtures, level 2, timed mode. Enjoy y'all!

notes.title: 0.2.14 Bigger, Better, Brighter!
notes.notes: Mostly brighter though, I increased the radius and brightness of the flashlight and added light fixtures throughout the office, some of which are on. The death sound effect has been toned down, and the click sound effect sounds like a mouse click now.

notes.title: Level 2 Jump Scare Tweaks
notes.notes: Made the model and sound scarier, they weren't scary enough

notes.title: Forget Something? 0.2.12 5/23/24
notes.notes: - Enemies on level two have been updated, they are faster, have a different appearance (notably), and a unique death sound effect

notes.title: Forget Something? 0.2.10 bug fixes mostly
notes.notes:
- fixed issue that disabled dropdowns on main menu after quitting from pause menu
- updated enemy navigation, so they should both get stuck less and clip through objects less
- player collision updated to make the player more easily able to fit through tight areas
- Key to level two can now be found in different rooms, and the location of the key is reflected in the objective text.

-[b]Still no mac support[/b], sorry Ben :(

notes.title: Timed mode and highscores
notes.notes:
- Timed mode
- Statistics! Beat your fastest times on each level
- [b]Still no mac support[/b] sorry I swear it's coming soon

notes.title: Medium Difficulty and Mac support
notes.notes:
- Difficulty Selector now has options for Easy and Medium, sending you to the first and second floor of the office building, respectively.

- LEVEL TWO! Once you select medium, you have to find the key to the stairs and unlock them. After going upstairs, your forgotten item will be somewhere in the maze of cubicles, the boss's office, the security room, or somewhere else in the sprawling upstairs area.

- Compass! Will point you to your forgotten item or the key to the stairs. It's still on you to find the stairs (and the way back out of the office).

- Post processing changes. Game looks better now ig

- Mac support!

- many more!
